strategy.thesis: Canada's largest angel investor network; while sector-agnostic, it maintains a deep bench of biopharma, oncology and medtech sector experts and, through its affiliated fund AQC Capital, is a recurring backer of Quebec's Life Sciences and Health Technologies (LSHT) cluster — one of the largest biomedical clusters in North America.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Sectoral-expert members include Michel Lussier (medtech/cell-therapy entrepreneur, co-founder of Celyad Oncology) and Louis-Martin Rousseau (co-founder of Gray Oncology Solutions); operates alongside its affiliated evergreen fund AQC Capital, which lists life sciences as one of its focus sectors.

summary.en: Founded in 2008 and based in Montréal, Anges Québec is Canada's largest angel investor network, deploying capital across sectors including Quebec's Life Sciences and Health Technologies cluster via sectoral experts in oncology, cell therapy and medtech and its affiliated fund AQC Capital.
